changes: Serialize all account expiry timestamps as UTC ISO-8601 with Z suffix
Represent active unlimited subscriptions with explicit unlimited metadata and Android-safe far-future expiry
Extend renewals from the current valid expiry and tolerate two minutes of provider clock skew
Long-poll BluePay for up to 30 seconds after returning from payment
Normalize gateway rial/toman values and block mismatched amounts
Persist redacted BluePay HTTP failures in a dedicated JSONL log
Grant one compensatory day when confirmation arrives more than one hour late
Serialize activation claims to avoid webhook/poll double provisioning
Synchronize GitHub Actions with latest branch and retry push after rebase
Cancel stale queued builds and upgrade official actions to Node 24 generations
